reviews.review:
Solid 8/10
A short linear shooter that you can complete in just a couple of hours with decent aim.
Game is not too difficult nor is it too easy, though obtaining gear requires a little bit of grinding remember to stock up on ammo. There is no checkpoint system in-stage therefore the whole level will restart upon failure.
Story and characters leave a lot to be desired, but are acceptable nonetheless.
There is a bug at the final stage which prevents the player character from firing after switching to the second cover position, but overall game-play was smooth without any crashes, graphical issues, or game breaking bugs.
